command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The chassis Links.Oem projection is at most discovery evidence; it neither proves complete Assembles coverage nor satisfies the conflicting Fans procedure, and its TLS/credential handling is unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After owner scope resolution, use protected traversal of explicitly approved collection, member and relationship resources plus synchronized UI evidence; retain the full graph rather than a projected Oem link object.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 10/10-minute estimates and conflicting Master wording remain unchanged; no configuration action is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce a deterministic ledger for each expected assembly with resource identity, role, parent, children, physical location, model/serial/asset data, optionality and SPEC disposition, backed by complete raw resources.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Separates navigation links from inventory evidence and exposes the Assembles-versus-Fans conflict before collection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A Links.Oem object proves neither membership completeness nor physical/relationship correctness.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Vendor schemas may represent parts through OEM resources, standard Chassis links or UI-only aggregation; only an approved topology can distinguish valid aliases from duplicates or missing hardware.

project_override_considerations: The Project must resolve scope and publish authoritative assembly resources, expected topology and optional/virtual rules. Physical disassembly, replacement, power cycling or LED actuation is outside this read-only row.
expected_evidence: Written Assembles-versus-Fans scope ruling and exact target identity
Approved resource/UI map and assembly member/relationship/location matrix
Complete protected raw collection/member/link payloads and synchronized UI capture
Per-member topology and field comparison with missing, extra, duplicate, dangling, stale and malformed findings
Same-target/no-mutation proof plus preserved audit, SEL and health evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items names Assembles, Procedure explicitly says Fans and DeepSeek assumes chassis/OEM links represent assemblies. These scopes and evidence models differ materially and cannot be silently reconciled.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Owner scope clarification and a vendor topology are normal project inputs. The case becomes blocked only if they remain unavailable or safe complete evidence cannot be collected after the normal request.

engineering_decision_request.question: Resolve whether Functionality row 1626 validates Assembles/chassis parts as stated by Items and implied by the DeepSeek resource, Fans as stated by Procedure, or separately accepted checkpoints; define the authoritative resources/UI, complete member/relationship/location matrix and disposition while preserving Master.

review_improvement: Prevents an OEM navigation object from being treated as a complete hardware inventory and establishes an owner-governed, topology-aware acceptance contract.
independent_technical_reasoning: A chassis assembly cannot be verified by the existence of vendor links. Completeness requires a closed expected topology: each fitted part must resolve to the correct parent, role and physical location, while optional and virtual members must be distinguished from omissions. The conflicting Fans instruction changes both the population and oracle, so it needs an explicit decision before evidence is meaningful.
